name: Rotate TOTP Recovery Codes
summary: Replaces the recovery-code set for the current authenticated identity while leaving TOTP enabled.

guards.expression: session-capability == authenticated-normal and TOTP is enabled for the current durable identity

sourceReferences.note: RotateRecoveryCodesAsync removes the existing recovery-code secret, stores a newly generated set, and returns the plaintext codes.
POST /api/auth/mfarecovery/rotate exposes the operation for a confirmed user.
